scope.author: 7db0e7b6-ab88-49e9-9362-a19121c8ebf5 (DEV ESPECIALISTA PEGADA)
scope.description: Full 12-frame rear axe grip cycle propagation on top of accepted body clip full-back-r-axe

contract1_bodyZeroRgbaDelta.details: All 12 frames in 256x256 are 100% byte-identical to body-specialist; all 12 frames in native 128x128 have exactly 0 RGBA pixel delta.

contract2_f04_f07_byteIdentity.details: F04 and F07 composite-256, composite-native-128, native body-128, and all four individual layers (weaponBack, body, weaponFront, handFront) are 100% byte-identical to the keys approved in rear-axe-grip-keys-result.json.

contract3_visibleIntervalAndBookends.details: visibleInterval is strictly [2, 8]. Bookends F00, F01, F09, F10, F11 have completely transparent weaponBack, weaponFront, and handFront layers (0 opaque pixels), and composite PNGs are 100% byte-identical to the unarmed body.

contract4_trajectoryAndGroundContact.details: Trajectory angles strictly follow [null, null, 305, 318, 330, 15, 75, 120, 105, null, null, null] degrees. F07 axe blade touches groundY=190 (native 126) at x=177, matching planted feet at y=190. F08 rests at y=188 without penetrating underground.

contract5_mastersVerification.details: Four canonical Aseprite masters verified on disk with exact matching SHA-256 hashes and 12-frame durations: composite.aseprite (3ca86a16ad1bb0e2...), body256.aseprite (e4aa361c8f905944...), native128.aseprite (f789d6b90d520ba1...), hand256.aseprite (a38a90db2ac6d66b...).

contract6_native128CropDiagnosis.details: The upper clipping of the axe head in F04 composite-native-128 is an artifact of the central [-64, -64] crop window for 128x128 preview. The canonical 256x256 composite canvas (standard for combat animations) retains the complete axe with zero clipping.

artisticObservations.gripQuality: In all 7 visible frames (F02..F08), the right glove genuine cluster encloses the handle haft naturally. Palm-wrist-forearm chain is continuous with zero floating stamps. Inactive left hand remains low near hip with zero weapon attachment.
artisticObservations.arcContinuity: The trajectory progresses logically: back-hoist preparation (305°) -> lift (318°) -> overhead apex (330°) -> rapid forward snap (15°, 50ms) -> mid cleave drive (75°, 60ms) -> ground impact (120°, 110ms) -> low settle (105°, 100ms). Weapon mass and silhouette remain stable without teleportation or loss of volume.
artisticObservations.neutralRecovery: Frames F09..F11 show seamless uncoiling of the body with zero leftover equipment artifacts or stray pixels.
artisticObservations.tacticalScaleReadability: Silhouette and weapon impact read clearly at both 128px native and 64px tactical scale.

limitations: EVALUATION_IS_STATIC_STILLS_AND_STRIPS: Multimodal inspection conducted frame by frame and across composite strips; continuous 1x real-time observation in live game engine was not directly observed.
LIMITED_SCOPE: Validates only the full cycle of back_r/Axe. Does not approve the other 3 rear body cycles (currently in repair), other 3 rear grips, 28-cell matrix, or Unity integration.
